QuestInfo.name: [Attack on Titan] On the Escape Ship
QuestInfo.0: It's an emergency! What to do?
QuestInfo.1: You climbed down the ladder and found a bunch of people boarding a ship. Might be a good idea to follow them.
QuestInfo.2: The people on the ship are escaping to a place called Wall Rose. You managed to board the ship before it set sail.
